submitted.rationale: Of the three merit measurements, the most Fe-rich composition (Fe0.81Sb0.19) had the highest EQE, 0.0057%. EQE dropped steeply as Sb increased: 0.0009% at Fe0.76 and about 0 at FeSbO4 (Fe0.51). This fits hematite-like absorption at 2.1 eV being the source of the photoresponse, so the best candidate is at the Fe-rich end of the line.
